slides.lead: It isn't dirt. It's dissolved rock.
Hard water carries dissolved calcium and magnesium. Heat it, and they come back out as a white crust.

steps: Rain falls on the land west of London.
It passes through chalk and limestone.
It picks up calcium and magnesium.

slides.lead: Both pass through the same chalky rock, so all of it ends up hard.
Measured as calcium carbonate. All water in Thames Water's region is hard.

paras: Thames Water says hard water is not considered harmful, and that its minerals are good for us, especially for bones.
The real cost is limescale: on kettles, showers and taps.

tips: Set your hot water to 60°C instead of hotter.
Put a steel scale collector in your kettle.
Empty the kettle when you're not using it.
